$comment: S2e item C: every native refusal row (N*), every DESIGN §12.2 Windows item (P*), the DPAPI tests (D*) and every shared contract case run natively (FS*). established = its test ran and passed in the Windows job; held = cannot be established in the job, with the reason; differs = declared in fs-windows-differences.json. test/fs-windows-gate.ts checks this against conformance.json.

N01.property: exclusive open refuses a PowerShell holder sharing read, write and delete; succeeds without it

N02.property: a second process cannot write after verify while the handle is held; bytes equal the hashed bytes; the write succeeds after close

N03.property: non-replacing rename refuses already-exists and leaves the destination unchanged; fs.renameSync replaces

N04.property: source swap and parent swap refuse identity-changed and parent-changed; the untouched open succeeds

N05.property: destination race before placement refuses already-exists and leaves the racer unchanged; placement succeeds without it

N06.property: hard link count 1 before fs.linkSync, 2 after; the open refuses hard-linked

N07.property: a junction in any parent refuses reparse; the path opens without it

N08.property: a same-size edit with mtime restored by fs.utimesSync moves ChangeTime; size and mtime equal before and after

N09.property: kill between §6.8 steps 1–4 leaves step n done, n+1 not started and the source intact; a DeleteOnClose holder loses its file; the Release build ignores the pause flag

N10.property: NTFS accepted as a supported local volume

N10R.property: ReFS refused or accepted per policy
N10R.reason: no ReFS volume in the job; releases when the job creates one and logs fsutil fsinfo volumeinfo for it

N10N.reason: no network volume in the job; releases when the job maps one and logs fsutil fsinfo volumeinfo for it

N10S.property: removable volume with a changed serial refused
N10S.reason: no removable volume in the job; releases when the job attaches one and logs fsutil fsinfo volumeinfo for it

P01.property: paths: spaces, dots and case resolve to one identity; invalid segments refused

P02.property: long paths beyond 260 characters open, hash and place

D01.property: DPAPI: kl token store writes a CurrentUser blob; kl token print cc --json prints exactly the header; the file holds no token form; the blob carries the DPAPI header

D02.property: DPAPI: a flipped byte makes kl token print exit non-zero with empty stdout

D03.property: DPAPI precedence: the stored token wins over KL_TOKEN_<KIND>; KL_TOKEN_FILE is refused on Windows

P06.property: git ls-files in a linked worktree
P06.reason: S2d's git port is run natively in a later session

P07.reason: needs the restore orchestration (S2 item 6) and a Kopia repository; not in S2e

FS02.property: contract: exact file, volume and every parent are bound

FS03.property: contract: replaced source name does not preserve identity

FS04.property: contract: replacement parent invalidates the chain

FS06.property: contract: hard links fail custody; copies have new identities

FS07.property: contract: unsupported volumes and a changed serial refuse
FS07.reason: no network, unknown or other volume and no serial change inside the job; releases when the job mounts such volumes

FS09.property: contract: held parent replacement is blocked; forced tampering is rechecked
FS09.reason: Windows refuses to rename a directory holding a file opened with no sharing, so the forced replacement cannot be made; the in-use refusal is asserted first

FS10.property: contract: create-new preserves normal, empty, identical, linked and reparse entries

FS11.property: contract: created and returned buffers are independent

FS12.property: contract: foreign, forged, closed and pre-crash handles never gain authority

FS14.property: contract: bound hashes do not follow source replacement
FS14.reason: Windows refuses to replace a file held with no sharing, so the replacement cannot be forced

FS15.property: contract: same size and restored mtime still changes ChangeTime; unknown ChangeTime
FS15.reason: ChangeTime is always known on NTFS; the unknown-ChangeTime tail cannot be made (the moving ChangeTime itself is N08)

FS16.property: contract: copying old mtime does not copy creation or identity

FS18.property: contract: read-only sealing requires attributes access; tampering stays detectable

FS19.property: contract: non-replacing placement preserves a target including a final-boundary race

FS20.property: contract: same-volume placement completes; cross-volume never falls back

FS21.property: contract: destination parent guards are checked at the final boundary
FS21.reason: the forced directory replacement cannot be made on Windows (see FS09)

FS22.property: contract: disposition requires delete access and rechecks link safety

FS23.property: contract: no delete-on-close on the source; explicit disposition survives a process crash

FS27.property: contract: ASCII aliases collide; unmodeled normalization refuses

FS30.property: contract: disposition cleanup reports uncertainty and preserves a substituted identity
FS30.reason: the substitution cannot be forced while the handle is held (see FS14)

FS31.property: contract: malformed parent segments cannot impersonate the chain

FS32.property: contract: bound SHA256 uses exact bytes and zero-length content
